title: Robust Native Language Identification through Agentic Decomposition

bias_targets.methodology: Appending misleading or supportive cultural stereotype statements (e.g., references to siestas, espresso, or baguettes) to input texts to measure whether the model's Native Language Identification (NLI) prediction relies on superficial cultural stereotypes rather than actual linguistic features.

Augmenting texts with explicit learner signatures containing nationality-specific names and geographic locations (e.g., a Spanish name and a Madrid address) to test if the model's prediction is disproportionately swayed by these demographic and geographic markers.
